adds.name: Winds of Abandon
adds.why: Nov 25, 2026 house pick for every white S-B deck. 2 mana: exile one creature you don't control; overload {4}{W}{W}: one-sided exile wipe that leaves T'Challa and the Vibranium board alone (better here than Vanquish the Horde or Scourglass). About $5-8 (Mystical Archive printing is cheapest). Cut not chosen.

adds.name: Court of Bounty
adds.why: From the History of Heroes kit (Nov 16). Makes you the monarch and drops a land or creature each upkeep. Vibranium can't pay for it. Suggested cut: Fleecemane Lion.

adds.name: Arc Reactor
adds.why: Freed by the Tony Stark fold (Nov 16). Five-mana artifact with improvise that grows T'Challa; sidegrade for Thran Dynamo.

adds.name: Mjölnir, Storm Hammer
adds.why: One copy from the History of Heroes kit, currently listed in Captain America: Shield Throw. If that deck is not built, it belongs here: a four-mana artifact Vibranium pays for, and it attaches itself.

name: Black Panther: Vibranium Forge
notes: Nov 25, 2026: main list reset to the exact stock Wakanda Forever precon (Birds of Paradise and Scourglass back; the Avacyn's Pilgrim and Aladdin's Ring edits moved into Crown & Forge or dropped). The Vibranium Forge version was cut; Crown & Forge is the one working version. Sleeved checklist trimmed to the Crown & Forge cards that were already checked. Dropped the old Talisman of Progress/Hierarchy idea: neither is legal in a G/W deck.
Nov 23, 2026: now the oldest's A-tier deck (swapped with Hulk).
Stock precon. Six directions: big artifacts, monarch, commander equipment, go-wide tokens, +1/+1 counters, and generic ramp. Scrollvault rates it a 4.6/10 Bracket 2 deck.

Vibranium tokens are indestructible artifacts that tap for {C}, and that mana can only cast artifact spells. T'Challa makes one when he enters or attacks and gets two +1/+1 counters whenever you cast an artifact with mana value 4 or more.

Weak spots: Divine Visitation, Martial Coup, Overwhelming Stampede, Vanquish the Horde and Harmonize can't use Vibranium mana. Coveted Jewel hands opponents mana and the crown in one hit. M'Baku gives an opponent the monarch.
source: Stock Wakanda Forever precon list (mtg.wtf), re-checked Nov 25, 2026

adds.name: The One Ring

adds.why: Bracket 3 Game Changer #2, replacing Harmonize. Treasures are artifacts: they feed Shuri, Colossus, Panther Robot, Nettlecyst and Omnitool.

variants.label: Crown & Forge
variants.name: Black Panther: Crown & Forge
notes: Plan: T'Challa attacks every turn for Vibranium, and the 4+ mana artifacts it pays for grow him and the team. Monarch is the card engine: Okoye, Ramonda, Nakia, T'Chaka, Palace Jailer, Spear, Frogs, Fight for the Throne, Herb and Throne of the High City. Evasion and vigilance keep the crown: Steel Seraph, Whispersilk Cloak, Rogue's Passage, Captain America's Shield, Super-Soldier Serum. Tokens crew the ships and become Angels: Divine Visitation turns Okoye's Soldiers, Kimoyo Beads, Royal Talon, Trading Post Goats, Mouser Robots and Martial Coup into 4/4 fliers.

Helm of the Host is a top engine: Hammer of Nazahn attaches it free on entry (or Super-Soldier Serum on attack), and each combat makes a hasty, nonlegendary T'Challa copy that makes Vibranium on entering and attacking and grows with every 4+ artifact. With Divine Visitation out the copy becomes a 4/4 hasty Angel instead, so pick which one to lean on.

Cut directions: Vanquish the Horde, Scourglass, +1/+1 counter filler (Loyal Guardian, Fleecemane Lion), slow value (Gilded Lotus, Conduit, Coveted Jewel, Greater Good, Mind's Eye) and conditional cards (Everett Ross, Hatut Zeraze, M'Baku, Loyal Retainers, Midnight Angel Armor, Ancestral Communion).

Counts (physically verified Nov 25): 22 creatures, 26 noncreature artifacts, 6 instants, 6 sorceries, 2 enchantments, 37 lands (12 Plains, 11 Forest, 14 nonbasic) = 99 + T'Challa. Roughly 10 ramp pieces plus Vibranium, 11 Equipment, 11 removal or wipes, 8 protection pieces.
Bracket 2: no Game Changers, no infinite combos, no land destruction. For Bracket 3, swap Trading Post, Harmonize and Heart-Shaped Herb for The One Ring, Smothering Tithe and Enlightened Tutor.
Don't Move: cast before combat and don't attack or crew that turn. Vibranium tokens aren't creatures, so tap them freely.
Super-Soldier Serum turns Colossus Hammer into a free +10/+10 on attack if you want a spicier swap.
Nov 9: Puresteel Paladin in for Ingenious Smith. With three artifacts every Equipment has equip {0} (Helm of the Host included), and each Equipment entering draws a card.
Nov 19: Mind Stone in for Birds of Paradise. An artifact rock counts for Puresteel metalcraft and improvise, doesn't die to wipes or Don't Move, and cycles for a card late.

Nov 24: Aladdin's Ring in for Scourglass. Scourglass wiped T'Challa and nearly every creature in the deck. The Ring is repeatable removal or reach (4 damage to any target), Vibranium can pay for it, and as an 8-MV artifact it triggers Zuri/W'Kabi/T'Challa and discounts Metalwork Colossus by 8.
Nov 25: Take up the Shield in for Valorous Stance and Overwhelming Stampede back in for Dispatch (neither on hand). Stampede is a one-card alpha strike once the board is wide; hold it for that.

Nov 25: Steel Seraph in for Iron Man Armor (not on hand). Same flying job plus vigilance or lifelink each combat, and it's a 6-MV artifact that grows T'Challa. Panther Habit and King Solomon's Frogs stay: both are among the deck's best cards.
Nov 25: Bast, Panther Goddess back in for Mind's Eye (Andrew's call; Dora Milaje Elite was the other candidate).
Nov 25: Wayfarer's Bauble in for Talisman of Unity (not on hand). Fetch a Plains; it's ramp that survives wipes as a land.
